goal: Preserve and continue the reviewed procedural Triceratops through a typed JSON AST and replayable transactions.

sources.license: User-authorized project reference; redistribution rights are not asserted

transformations.operation: Evaluate whitelisted SDF, deformation, attachment, material, lighting, validation, and export nodes from stable IDs.
transformations.loss: Rigging, skin weights, and animation are not represented.

observations.claim: The reviewed candidate contains one watertight structural shell, 27 replaceable attachments, and 18,614 total triangles.
The result improved during the guided review but still requires user approval against the reference.

assumptions: The approved visual reference remains the art-direction authority.
A reviewed candidate must not replace a production gameplay model until rigging and user approval are complete.
uncertainties: The muzzle, frill rim, toe anatomy, and horn-to-skull transitions remain less faithful than the reference.
No Blender-native round-trip claim is made.
